Malcolm, 2026-08-25: get the style to fit skingenetix-pdrn-copper-peptide-skin-renewal-diagram more, because the two have to work as a PAIR; and show a clear wrinkle in the skin so you can see the damage underneath.

BOTH BLOCKS ARE RE-RUN, NOT ONE. The published approach diagram has a CLINICAL BLUE fibre network; the causes re-run went REDDISH PINK, at Malcolm's instruction and with the anatomy on its side. One image cannot be made to pair with the other by changing only itself when the colours disagree, so the approach frame is re-run here in the same reddish pink. That gives a genuinely matched pair to judge. If he would rather the pair stayed blue, the causes brief drops back to 014EB1 and nothing else changes.

STYLE IS NOW STATED AS A COPY OF THE PUBLISHED FRAME, because 'in the style of the Matrixyl set' was too loose and round 2 drifted into a dense anatomical-atlas look — beautiful, but a different world from its own partner. What the published approach diagram actually does, and what both slots now specify:
  - a clean CUBE of skin at a low three-quarter angle, top surface and one cut face visible, floating on a very pale gradient ground with no hard shadow
  - a neat quilted top surface of pale peach polygonal plates
  - three or four rows of ROUNDED TRANSLUCENT pearl-cream cells beneath it, the bottom row largest
  - fibre drawn as SMOOTH GLOSSY TUBES with clean specular highlights, generously spaced, waving horizontally and running out past the block on both sides
  - calm and uncrowded, with real space between elements
Round 2's dermis failed on that last point above all: it was a dense packed mat of fibrous material. The word 'packed' has been removed from this brief and replaced with a spacing instruction, because 'completely filled' was my fix for the round-1 hole and it overshot into a different fault. FILLED AND UNCROWDED ARE BOTH ACHIEVABLE; the round-1 void and the round-2 mat are two ends of the same knob.

THE WRINKLE IS THE NEW CONTENT AND IT CARRIES THE ARGUMENT. One deep V-shaped fold crosses the top surface, and directly beneath it the dermis is visibly collapsed — the junction flattened, the bundles broken, slumped and disordered, sagging away from the fold — while further along the same block they are thicker and better ordered. The wrinkle and the damage under it are therefore one causal picture rather than two facts side by side. This is the same response-gradient device used on the Matrixyl f1 frame: one continuous surface, two states, no split screen and no comparison frame.

STILL NO EMPTY SPACE. The round-1 void came from my own clause asking for wide empty gaps. Collapse is shown as bundles pressed down, broken and tangled — still occupying the space — never as a hole.

CAUSES CARRIES NO DELIVERY VOCABULARY: no spheres, no shafts, no glints. APPROACH CARRIES ALL OF IT, with the molecule spec restated exactly, because nbp_pro drew GHK-Cu with five beads last time and that is the wrong molecule: four spheres, two flat untwisted ladders of no more than six rungs, and two chains of EXACTLY THREE beads with a copper centre.

Square 2048x2048. CLASS B, no references, all six suppliers.

slots.title: causes · one deep wrinkle, with the collapse beneath it visible
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a very pale gradient background with no hard shadow. Square format. Calm and uncrowded, with clear space between the elements.

A clean cube-shaped block of skin floats at a low three-quarter angle so that both its top surface and one cut face are visible. The top surface is a neat quilted skin of pale peach polygonal plates. Directly beneath it sit three or four rows of large rounded translucent pearl-cream cells, the bottom row the largest. Below those, filling the lower half of the block and extending out past it to the left and right, is the dermis, drawn as SMOOTH GLOSSY TUBES with clean bright highlights, generously spaced with visible gaps of soft pink ground between them, waving horizontally — never a dense packed mat. The tubes are a warm reddish pink, colour hex C4566B, and among them run much finer pale pink threads, a few slender hairpin capillary loops in deeper red, colour hex A32B3C, rising toward the cells above, and a handful of small spindle-shaped cells with long tapering arms. A single row of large rounded pale cream lobules sits along the very bottom.

ONE DEEP WRINKLE CROSSES THE TOP SURFACE. It runs diagonally across the block as a distinct V-shaped fold with steep walls, deep enough to be unmistakable at a glance, its plates crowded up and lifting along both of its edges. It is the clear focal point of the picture.

DIRECTLY UNDERNEATH THE WRINKLE THE STRUCTURE HAS GIVEN WAY, and the picture makes that connection plain. Under the fold the boundary between the pearl cells and the pink tubes is almost FLAT, with only worn-down traces of the finger-like interlocking ridges that should be there; the tubes beneath are broken into short frayed lengths, slumped and lying in disorder, pressed down and sagging away beneath the fold; the fine threads there are snarled into small thickened clumps and the capillary loops are shortened stubs. Toward the far end of the same block, away from the fold, that boundary still shows shallow interlocking ridges and the tubes there run thicker, longer and in ordered parallel waves. The change between the two is smooth and continuous across one single block.

At the surface the plates are dull and matte as though they have stayed far too long, and fine dark grey specks drift down out of the hazy air and settle across them. Nothing is being applied: the air above holds only haze and those specks, with no spheres, no beads, no beams of light and no bright glints anywhere. Soft diffuse light, shallow depth of field, the far edge dissolving into pale haze. Glossy and immaculate, but quiet.

slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a very pale gradient background with no hard shadow. Square format. Calm and uncrowded, with clear space between the elements.

A clean cube-shaped block of skin floats at a low three-quarter angle so that both its top surface and one cut face are visible. The top surface is a neat quilted skin of pale peach polygonal plates, fine, even and completely unbroken across the whole block. Directly beneath it sit three or four rows of large rounded translucent pearl-cream cells, the bottom row the largest and roundest. Below those, filling the lower half of the block and extending out past it to the left and right, is the dermis, drawn as SMOOTH GLOSSY TUBES with clean bright highlights, generously spaced with visible gaps of soft pink ground between them, waving horizontally — never a dense packed mat. The tubes are a warm reddish pink, colour hex C4566B, and among them run much finer pale pink threads, a few slender hairpin capillary loops in deeper red, colour hex A32B3C, rising toward the cells above, and a handful of small spindle-shaped cells with long tapering arms. A single row of large rounded pale cream lobules sits along the very bottom.

FOUR TRANSLUCENT SPHERES OF CLEAR PALE BLUE FLOAT ABOVE THE SURFACE, AND THEY HOLD TWO DIFFERENT THINGS. Two of them each hold a short flat ladder of small pearl-white beads: two straight parallel rows of beads lying side by side joined by fine short rungs, flat and untwisted like a tiny stepladder seen face-on, with no more than six rungs. The other two each hold a chain of exactly three beads in a row, the outer two pearl-white and the middle one a polished copper bead, colour hex B87333.

From the underside of every sphere a slender shaft of warm white light descends, and THE TWO KINDS REACH DIFFERENT DEPTHS. The shafts from the two ladder spheres stop at the bottom row of the pearl cells. The shafts from the two copper-bead spheres pass through the cells and continue down among the pink tubes below.

WHERE EACH SHAFT ARRIVES A BRIGHT STAR-SHAPED GLINT BURSTS. At the bottom cell row the cells are plump, rounded and lit from within, one drawn into a soft figure-of-eight as it divides in two, and a single bright new cell rises through the row above it. Among the pink tubes, around the copper shafts, the tubes are thicker, longer and more numerous with several fine bright new ones weaving in among them, and the boundary above them shows deep finger-like interlocking ridges; further from any shaft they are thinner and the change is smooth and gradual. Small bright sparkles drift in the lit zones. Soft diffuse light, shallow depth of field, the far edge dissolving into pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.
